analysis.reasoning: TSMC management demonstrated high confidence in their technological moat (N5, N3) and aggressive expansion, evidenced by raising full-year CapEx guidance. While they acknowledged significant macro risks including COVID-19 and US trade regulations (Huawei), the upward revision of revenue growth guidance to >20% suggests strong demand in 5G and HPC segments. The management was somewhat evasive regarding specific customer impacts and segment breakdowns during Q&A, but provided high quantitative specificity regarding margins and technology nodes.
